film.title: Learn GCP by building a media & broadband analytics platform: full course, beginner to professional
film.blurb: Every local number is really computed: PostgreSQL 18.6, Python 3.14.9 and Beam's direct runner. Every GCP resource is Terraform. The steps marked recorded were run once in a real project, their transcripts kept, then torn down. The rest says so on screen: emulated (fake-gcs-server, the Pub/Sub emulator), doc-cited, a model, or mocked. Mocked outputs (two steps of the BigQuery Silver build, and Courses 9–12) are written to match the code and the night's data, not run.
